title: ast.undefined_names response
description: Single-file undefined-identifier diagnostics. Coordinates are 0-based to match the rest of `ast::*` builtins. Diagnostics are deduplicated by name (first occurrence wins) so callers see one entry per missing import / typo, not one per usage.

supported.description: False when no profile exists for the resolved language. In that case `diagnostics` is empty.

Resolution.description: How far this file's name analysis can be trusted. A diagnostic is evidence of a defect only when `complete` is true; otherwise an unresolved name may simply be one this single-file analysis could not see.

complete.description: True only when the analysis ran, the language's ceiling is `single_file_complete`, and the file introduced no defeater.

analysed.description: False when no analysis ran at all: an unsupported language, or a file that did not parse. Distinguishes `we looked and found nothing` from `we did not look`.

ceiling.description: The language's limit. `single_file_complete`: every name must be imported or bound in this file. `package_scoped`: sibling files in the same package contribute names with no import. `runtime_resolved`: names are routinely created at runtime.

defeaters.description: Constructs found in this file that defeat resolution, each reported once.

kind.description: Reference flavor: `identifier` for value-side references, `type` for TypeScript type-only references.
